Home.savoirFaireTitle: An extensive expertise to dress all your spaces.
Home.pillar1Text: We speak a common language with our clients: that of beauty and durability. A keen eye, demanding hands, fabrics selected for their hold, their drape, and their presence.
Home.pillar2Text: The same requirement on both sides of the threshold. Indoor to dress the space, outdoor to brave the sun, water, and time — without ever sacrificing aesthetics.
Home.pillar3Text: From brief to delivery: samples, color advice, yardage, and project tracking. A dedicated team for professionals and individuals alike.

Home.projetText: Architects, hoteliers, decorators, and individuals: Kansotex accompanies you from the choice of material to manufacturing and implementation. Our team is at your disposal to bring your spaces to life.

Universes.title: Our universes
Universes.subtitle: Kansotex, the requirement of the material for every space.
Universes.description: From the living room to the terrace, from the bedroom to the bathroom: a textile house that connects indoor and outdoor, linens and furniture, everyday use and high-end.
Universes.universe_indoor_excerpt: Upholstery fabrics, sheers, and textures designed to dress living rooms, hotels, and residences.
Universes.universe_outdoor_excerpt: Technical and aesthetic fabrics for terraces, gardens, riads, and outdoor hospitality spaces.
Universes.universe_linge-de-maison_excerpt: Tablecloths, table runners, throws, and textile pieces that set the tone for a table or living room.
Universes.universe_linge-de-lit_excerpt: Sheets, covers, and pillowcases in linen and cotton, for hotel-quality sleep and refined guest rooms.
Universes.universe_linge-de-bain_excerpt: Towels, bathrobes, and bath mats: absorption, density, and a discreet presence in the bathroom.
Universes.universe_tissus-haut-de-gamme_excerpt: A demanding material library: rare weaves, custom colors, and fabrics for exceptional projects.

SavoirFaire.title: Our expertise
SavoirFaire.subtitle: A culture of material, at the service of your projects.
SavoirFaire.step1Text: Usage, light, climate, style. We listen to the project — riad, hotel, villa, restaurant, or home — to set the right constraints.
SavoirFaire.step2Text: Samples, palettes, yard tests. Indoor or outdoor, linens or furniture: each fabric is chosen for its hand, its hold, and its character.
SavoirFaire.step3Text: Yardages, deadlines, coordination with workshops and decorators. Unique tracking until installation and delivery.

About.title: About us
About.subtitle: Kansotex, in & outdoor
About.p1: Kansotex is a textile house dedicated to both the interior and the exterior. We select and accompany high-end fabrics, from home linens to bed and bath linens, for residential, hotel, and interior architecture projects.
About.p2: Our view is one of detail: drape, color, resistance, hand. Indoor, we dress living rooms, bedrooms, and tables. Outdoor, we make the material withstand the sun, water, and time — without ever compromising on elegance.
About.p3: Professionals and individuals move forward with the same requirement: a clear material library, frank advice, project tracking until installation.
